source_title: Save $350 on the Pixel 11 Pro XL gets in record-low deal
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
The Google Pixel 11 Pro XL just dropped to a record-low $949 on Amazon, down from its $1,299 recommended retail price. That’s a $350 discount, or 27% off RRP, and it’s a strong time to grab Google’s top big-screen phone for a lot less.
This is the flagship Pixel for people who want the full package. The Pixel 11 Pro XL has a 6.8-inch high-resolution OLED display, Google’s new Tensor G6 chip, and a big focus on camera upgrades. Google also built it around stronger durability and on-device Gemini-powered AI features, so it’s aimed at buyers who want premium hardware with smart tools built in.
Battery life looks like one of the big highlights here. The phone packs a 5,115mAh battery and faster 45W charging than the smaller Pro model, which should make it a better fit for heavier daily use. Reviews also describe it as polished and reliable, with photography, display quality, and day-to-day smart features standing out. It also has a 4.4-star Amazon rating, which adds to the appeal.
The Pixel 11 Pro XL launched in August 2026, so this is still a very new phone, and seeing it hit a record-low price this early makes the deal stand out even more. If you’ve been waiting for a real price cut on Google’s biggest and most full-featured Pixel, this is one worth checking out now.
